results.title: NCQA's first CMO aims to modernize quality measurement for the AI era
results.description: Quality measurement has influenced American healthcare for decades and has been essential to improving the care delivery process and boosting patient outcomes. But many clinicians still often experience it as an expanding list of reporting requirements, rather than a tool that improves care. "Quality measures land, ultimately, on clinicians," said Dr. Ari Robicsek. "They're at the pointy end of the stick."
